en: Black‑and‑white view of a European city square with landscaped gardens in the foreground, a fenced path where a woman in light-colored dress walks, and a tall column in the center topped by a winged female figure holding a wreath. Surrounding the monument are ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with steep roofs and decorative facades. The scene has the look of an old photographic postcard, though no border text or caption is visible.
